caption: The drawing depicts a square textile with a repeating symmetrical pattern on a beige or light tan background. The textile is divided into four large squares, each containing a circular wreath made up of alternating green, red, and orange leaves. Inside each circle are four heart-shaped objects arranged in a clover-like pattern, two of which are green and two are red. In the corners between the circles, there are additional heart-shaped objects, either green or orange. The textile is bordered on two visible sides with a pattern of alternating green, red, and orange leaf shapes between two parallel lines. The overall color palette consists primarily of green, red, orange, and beige. The drawing is rendered with visible strokes and has a hand-drawn effect.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
